description: Port GaganEA v2.12's current entry/exit logic to Python as a clean, testable, pluggable Strategy, and build the runner CLI. Add a Strategy base class so NEW strategies can be dropped in easily (the whole point: try many strategy ideas in-sandbox). Port the GaganEA strategy faithfully (not byte-exact): HTF EMA200 + CTF EMA200 trend agreement, Min_EMA_Distance gate, ATR regime filter, EMA pullback-and-resume + entry RSI confluence, session filter, and the exit stack (ATR dynamic SL/TP, ATR-scaled T1/T2/T3 tiers, breakeven-after-T1, trailing). Parameters map to the SAME names/roles as the EA inputs and the 11 tuner params so parameter search is meaningful. Then a runner CLI to backtest a strategy on the data with metrics + tuner score + diagnosis, JSON output, and A/B comparison. Depends on FEAT-001 + FEAT-002. STDLIB ONLY, pure ASCII, Python 3.9+.
steps: STRATEGY BASE python_bt/strategy/__init__.py + base.py: define an abstract Strategy base class with a clear pluggable interface: __init__(self, params: dict) storing validated params; a class attribute NAME and a class-level default_params() classmethod; and hooks the engine calls, e.g. on_bar(self, bar, ctx) and optionally on_tick(self, tick, ctx) where ctx exposes broker actions (ctx.buy/ctx.sell/ctx.positions/ctx.close_partial/ctx.modify_sl) and market/indicator helpers. Provide a simple STRATEGY REGISTRY (dict name->class, plus a register decorator) so runner can look up strategies by name and new strategies self-register on import. Keep the interface minimal and documented so adding a strategy = subclass + register.

INDICATORS python_bt/indicators.py: stdlib implementations of the indicators the port needs, computed incrementally over the M5 bar stream (and H1 for HTF EMA): EMA (with period, standard 2/(n+1) smoothing; seed with SMA of first n), ATR (Wilder's, period 14, from bar high/low/close), RSI (Wilder's, period 14, from bar closes). Design them as small stateful objects (update(value)->current) so they run O(1) per bar over the stream, not recomputed from scratch. Provide an H1 aggregation for the HTF EMA200 (aggregate M5 bars or ticks to H1, or maintain an H1 EMA fed by hourly closes derived from the tick stream). Unit-test each indicator against a hand-computed short series.

GAGAN PORT python_bt/strategy/gagan.py: implement GaganStrategy(Strategy) faithful to GaganEA.mq5 v2.12 (reference OpenTrade ~572, ManageTargets ~808, helpers GetATR/SessionOK/BullPullbackResume/BearPullbackResume/GetEntryRSI ~475-560). Params dict uses the SAME names as the EA inputs / tuner params: Risk_Percent, Min_EMA_Distance, Min_Trade_Distance, StopLoss_Pips, T1_Pips, T2_Pips, T3_Pips, T1_ClosePercent, T2_ClosePercent, Entry_Cooldown_Bars, Max_Concurrent_Positions (the 11 tuner params) PLUS the Round 4 structural params EMA_Period_HTF=200, EMA_Period_CTF=200, ATR_Period=14, ATR_Min_Points=150, ATR_Max_Points=4000, ATR_SL_Mult=1.5, ATR_TP_Mult=2.5, Use_ATR_Scaled_Tiers=True, ATR_T1_Mult=0.8/ATR_T2_Mult=1.5/ATR_T3_Mult=2.2, RSI_Entry_Period=14, RSI_Buy_Max=68, RSI_Sell_Min=32, Pullback_Lookback=6, Session_Start_Hour=7, Session_End_Hour=20, Trail_Step_Pips=400, and the on/off switches (Use_Confluence_Entry, Use_ATR_Regime_Filter, Use_ATR_Dynamic_SLTP, Use_Session_Filter). Use params.py defaults/validate for the 11 tuner params (import automation.tuner.params validate to snap/clamp/order-repair when params are supplied) so the Python and MT5 param spaces agree. ENTRY (on M5 bar close): compute htfBull/htfBear (mid vs HTF EMA200), ctfBull/ctfBear (mid vs CTF EMA200), dist in points >= Min_EMA_Distance; SessionOK (hour in [Start,End)); ATR regime (atr_points in [Min,Max]); confluence BUY = BullPullbackResume (within last Pullback_Lookback bars a bar low<=emaCTF, last closed bar close>emaCTF) AND entry RSI<=RSI_Buy_Max; mirror SELL; respect Entry_Cooldown_Bars and Max_Concurrent_Positions. Lot sizing per CalcLotSize: riskAmt=balance*Risk_Percent/100; lots=riskAmt/((slDist/TICK_SIZE)*TICK_VALUE) then normalize/cap. EXIT: ATR SL = ask-ATR_SL_Mult*atr (clamp to a min-stop constant), TP=slDist*(ATR_TP_Mult/ATR_SL_Mult); tiers T1/T2/T3 in points = ATR_Tx_Mult*atr/POINT_SIZE when Use_ATR_Scaled_Tiers else fixed Tx_Pips; at each tier close T1_ClosePercent then T2_ClosePercent of remaining, T3 full close; breakeven-after-T1 (move SL to entry); trailing by Trail_Step_Pips after T2. Document every place the Python port APPROXIMATES the MQL5 (e.g. bar-close decisions, ATR/RSI seeding, H1 EMA construction) in module docstring + comments. This is a faithful reimplementation, NOT a byte-exact clone.

RUNNER CLI python_bt/runner.py with `if __name__=='__main__'` and module entry so `python3 -m python_bt.runner ...` works: argparse flags --data <csv> (default the extracted CSV path), --strategy <name> (registry lookup; default gagan), --params <json string or @file.json>, --from YYYY.MM.DD, --to YYYY.MM.DD, --mode {bar,tick} (default bar/fast), --max-ticks N (smoke cap), --json <outpath> (emit the result dict), --compare (see next). It runs the engine, then prints: the metrics block + the tuner SCORE + a short diagnosis reusing tools/analyze_report.py's diagnosis vocabulary/thresholds where practical (import build_diagnosis/diagnosis_verdict from tools.analyze_report by adding tools to sys.path, or replicate the threshold-based flags minimally with a note) so Python-side output speaks the same language as the MT5 analyzer. A/B: --compare accepts two --params (or two --strategy) and prints both metric sets + scores side by side and which scored higher, so the user (and the orchestrator) can directly eyeball whether a new idea is better. Make output both human-readable and, with --json, machine-readable.

TESTS python_bt/tests/test_indicators.py + test_gagan.py + test_runner.py: indicators vs hand-computed short series (EMA seed+step, RSI Wilder on a known series, ATR on known bars). Gagan: build a tiny synthetic M5 bar/tick fixture engineered to (a) trigger a BUY when all gates align and (b) be REJECTED when one gate fails (e.g. RSI overbought, wrong session hour, ATR below Min, no pullback-resume) - assert entry/skip; assert lot sizing math for a known balance/SL; assert a T1 partial then breakeven-SL move happens on a scripted winning path. Runner: invoke the CLI entry function on a tiny generated CSV (written to a temp path in the exact tab format) with --max-ticks and assert it returns/prints metrics + a score without error and that --json writes valid JSON. Do NOT use the 526MB CSV in tests.

VERIFY: python3 -m py_compile new modules+tests; python3 -m unittest discover -s python_bt/tests -p 'test_*.py' -q (all green); run the CLI on a SMALL SLICE of the REAL extracted CSV to prove end-to-end (e.g. `python3 -m python_bt.runner --data data/XAUUSD_202607011100_202609011203/XAUUSD_202607011100_202609011203.csv --strategy gagan --to 2026.07.02 --mode bar` or --max-ticks 500000) and CAPTURE the printed metrics+score (label as an unvalidated small-slice smoke test); grep -nP non-ASCII (empty); tools (16) + tuner (38) suites still green; GaganEA.mq5 untouched.
acceptance_criteria: A Strategy base class + registry exists so a new strategy is added by subclassing and registering; GaganStrategy is registered under name 'gagan'.

GaganStrategy faithfully reimplements v2.12 entry (HTF+CTF EMA200 trend, Min_EMA_Distance, ATR regime, pullback-resume + entry RSI confluence, session filter, cooldown, concurrent cap) and exit (ATR dynamic SL/TP, ATR-scaled or fixed T1/T2/T3 tiers, breakeven-after-T1, trailing), with params named the same as the EA inputs / 11 tuner params.
The 11 tuner-managed params are validated via automation/tuner/params.validate so the Python and MT5 param spaces agree; approximations vs MQL5 are documented in the module.
Indicators (EMA/ATR/RSI) are incremental and unit-tested against hand-computed series.

`python3 -m python_bt.runner --data <csv> --strategy gagan [--from --to] [--mode] [--params json] [--json out]` runs a backtest and prints metrics + tuner score + diagnosis; --compare A/Bs two param sets / strategies; --json emits valid JSON.
The CLI runs end-to-end on a small slice of the REAL extracted CSV and produces metrics + a score.
All new unit tests pass on tiny fixtures (no 526MB dependency); new files pure ASCII; GaganEA.mq5 untouched; tools 16 + tuner 38 suites still green.
verification: python3 -m py_compile python_bt/indicators.py python_bt/strategy/base.py python_bt/strategy/gagan.py python_bt/runner.py

python3 -m python_bt.runner --data data/XAUUSD_202607011100_202609011203/XAUUSD_202607011100_202609011203.csv --strategy gagan --to 2026.07.02 --mode bar  (prints metrics + score; small-slice smoke test)
cd automation/tuner && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q  (expect 38 OK)
findings:
IMPLEMENTED. New modules: python_bt/indicators.py (incremental EMA/ATR/RSI + H1Ema HTF EMA200 aggregator, all O(1)/bar, SMA-seeded, unit-tested vs hand-computed series); python_bt/strategy/__init__.py + base.py (abstract Strategy base with NAME/default_params()/on_bar/on_tick + STRATEGY_REGISTRY dict and @register decorator; gagan self-registers on import of the package); python_bt/strategy/gagan.py (GaganStrategy faithful port of v2.12 entry+exit core); python_bt/runner.py (argparse CLI, `python3 -m python_bt.runner`). Tests added: test_indicators.py (7), test_gagan.py (12), test_runner.py (4).

PARAM VALIDATION: gagan imports automation/tuner/params.py (sys.path bootstrap like scoring_bridge) and runs validate() over ONLY the 11 tuner-managed params in __init__, snapping/clamping/order-repairing them so Python and MT5 spaces agree; structural Round 4 params/switches are left as-is.

APPROXIMATIONS (documented in gagan.py docstring, UNVERIFIABLE in-sandbox): (1) bar-close timing - entries decided in on_bar on the just-closed M5 bar; in bar mode SL/TP fire only at each bar's closing quote (engine.py limitation), tick mode fires per-tick and gagan.on_tick runs tier/SL management every tick. (2) indicator seeding via SMA of first n (MT5 exact seed not byte-specified). (3) H1 EMA200 built from hourly closes sampled off the M5 stream (last M5 mid close of each hour), not a broker H1 series. (4) OHLC built from tick MIDs, so trend/distance comparisons use mid where the EA reads BID; fills still use real bid/ask via the broker. (5) MIN_STOP_POINTS / MIN_LOT / LOT_STEP are documented constants (CONFIRM vs broker). Legacy sub-systems intentionally NOT ported (candlestick/chart patterns, AMA exit, reversal exit, basket trailing, master/global EP, news, dashboard) - documented in module docstring; when Use_Confluence_Entry is off there is no legacy pattern fallback so no entry fires (noted in code).

VERIFICATION (all green): py_compile all new modules+tests OK. python_bt suite: 60 tests OK (prior 37 + FEAT-001 + 23 new). tools suite: 16 OK. tuner suite (from automation/tuner): 38 OK. ASCII: grep -rnP non-ASCII over python_bt/*.py empty. GaganEA.mq5: git status clean (untouched).
